name: Shot_DrawBeamQueue
comment: Restore-phase beam replot entry: called only from Frame_RestoreViewportRectsAndParticles (0x00439d20). Loops the 0x40-slot g_beam_hit_queue and replays each live beam into the saved-backdrop surface via SWBeams_DrawKinkedBeam (field_0x76 < 1, 1-segment) or SWBeams_DrawBeamWithFlare (field_0x76 >= 1, 2-segment arc). The port keeps no saved-backdrop buffer, so this entry point is not reproduced, but the two plotters it calls are also reachable from the visible 0x00438810 twin-surface path and are tracked separately. 0%, not ported.

name: Registration_SpawnLicenseEnforcer
comment: Shareware/license enforcement encounter using personality slot 0x3ff; day thresholds and licensed-runtime flags gate a near-player state-8 spawn. Renamed in Ghidra from the misleading Mission_SpawnAmbientMissionShip; unported.

name: Outfit_EvaluateRequireMask
comment: Require-mask satisfaction routed through the ship-class-seeded ContributeMask (landed_store MeetsRequire)

name: SWBeams_DrawBeamSegment
comment: Pixel-copy primitive used only by the erase/save-restore pass; subsumed by SDL back buffering. Deliberately skipped.

name: SWBeams_PlotBresenhamLine
comment: Pixel copy between surfaces (erase pass); subsumed by SDL. Deliberately skipped.

name: SWBeams_DrawKinkedBeam
comment: Kinked/offset beam plotter (source+target, width, colour) from SWBeams.c. Reachable from the visible Shot_DrawBeamHitQueueForSurface (0x00438810) field_0xec != 0 twin-surface branches and from the restore pass (0x004386f0). The port's DrawBeamCoreAndCorona (SWBeams_DrawShortBeam 0x00479fe0) covers only the normal non-twin simple-beam path, so this plotter is not reproduced yet. 0%, not ported.

name: SWBeams_DrawBeamWithFlare
comment: Thick/flare beam plotter (width-graded rows, flare alpha from field_0x78) from SWBeams.c. Reachable from the same visible 0x00438810 field_0xec != 0 twin-surface branches and the restore pass (0x004386f0) as SWBeams_DrawKinkedBeam; the normal visible thick path uses the ported SWBeams_DrawThickFadingBeam (0x0047a410). Not reproduced yet. 0%, not ported.

name: SWBeams_SetupAndClipSegment
comment: Software clip-rect walk; SDL clips rendered points to the viewport. Deliberately skipped.

name: NovaUi_RunBarGamblingWindow
comment: Bar Gamble button; the 0x2152+ flash PICTs are the gambling-machine animation; bet 1000/10000 arms

name: NovaUi_DrawBarGamblingWindow
comment: Draw callback of the bar gambling window 0x0047dc50. Not yet ported.

name: Ui_PlayMovieFileInRect
comment: Plays a named QuickTime movie ("9:Nova Plug-ins:<name>" then "9:Nova Files:<name>") into an explicit rect; shipyard per-ship MovieFile preview loop. Unported (QuickTime replaced by SDL).

name: SpriteWorld_InitializeFlightViewSpritePools
comment: PROVISIONAL Ghidra rename (was FUN_004abd8d): flight-view sprite bootstrap from NovaUi_InitializeFlightViewSurfaces (via FUN_008757c0); installs sprite-world hooks and clones/attaches every pooled sprite instance. Not yet ported.

name: NovaInput_PumpAndHasPendingEvents
comment: Pump + return DAT_008701a0 pending flag. 0% unported.

name: FUN_004bcd30
comment: Not ported as a unit. Its DrawTextW(DT_WORDBREAK) multi-line layout -- including the double-return blank line the desc resources place before "Requires: ..." -- is mirrored by WrapDescriptionLines (src/game/landed_window.cpp); the fill+invert draw is reproduced inline at each call site. UiWindow_Draw's static-text arm reuses WrapDescriptionLines plus item-rect clipping (ui_dialog.cpp).

name: IniConfig_GetSectionString
comment: Reads EVNova.ini "<section>" / "S<index>" into a buffer (Pilots folder, Last Pilot marker, prefs name, error strings). Unported; port uses fixed literals.

name: Prefs_SetPilotsPathPrefix
comment: Builds the "Pilots:" prefix from EVNova.ini [130] S3. Former Ghidra name Prefs_SetNovaFilesPathPrefix was wrong. Unported; the port resolves a "Pilots" child of the per-user support folder (src/nova_paths.cpp, used by src/game/pilot_file.cpp PilotFileSaveDirectory).

name: PilotDebug_WritePilotLog
comment: debug-only pilotlog.txt dump (licensed runtime only); not reconstructed

name: Resource_LoadRandomStringEntry
comment: Loads a random STR# entry into a caller buffer. The port reimplements the logic inline at each call site (e.g. mission_script.cpp LoadRandomStringListEntry) rather than as one helper, so no impl_file yet.

name: ResourceData_VerifyCatalogChecksum
comment: Full-catalog resource integrity check: sums FUN_004fe285 over 0x17 resource types and compares to the stored checksum in resource type 0x63739f6d, showing STR# 0x8c entry 7 on mismatch. Called between the startup splash and the progress-bar reveal. Deliberately not ported (licence/tamper checks out of scope); the loading bar therefore appears immediately on the startup splash instead of after this pass.

name: NovaMouse_GetWindowRelativePosition
comment: Mouse minus current window record origin. 0% unported.

name: FUN_004d4480
comment: NovaTime_GetSharewareDayCounter: (UTC now - DAT_00870900)/0x15180 + 1 with a 0x5a floor for pre-release clocks. Not reimplemented (shareware trial state deliberately absent from the clean-room).

name: NovaSound_ExpandIma4Samples
comment: snd sample expansion (v+0x80) dup quirk; decoded in NovaSound_DecodePayload

name: Path_GetModulePathMac
comment: Full path -> Mac-style "<drive>:a:b" prefix string. Unported.

name: ResourceData_FindNodeForHandle
comment: Resource-registry handle lookup: walks registry nodes (head DAT_00864f38) to find the owner of a locked block handle; used by ResourceData_ResolveSlotByHandle and ResourceData_ReleaseEntry.

name: MemOrStream_ResolveId
comment: Registry id resolver, provisional: opens the entry for a small-int resource id against a registry root; callers chain it for path resolution (MemOrStream_OpenOrResolvePath 0x004da370).

name: Debug_HandleCheatAndNcbCommands
comment: Cheat-mode arming plus debug NCB condition-test/set-script dialogs; called from Ship_HandlePlayerShipCore and returns the caller's command probe. Renamed in Ghidra from the misleading Mission_TickReactionInputTrigger; unported debug path.

name: NovaUi_ScaleRectInPlace
comment: CE ui_scale helper: multiplies a QuickDraw rect's four shorts by g_ui_scale with x87 half-up rounding. No-op at scale 1.0; port has no ui_scale model.

name: Settings_LoadUiScale
comment: CE-only experimental UI scaling (CE src/scale-dlog.c): reads ddraw.ini [EV Nova] ui_scale (default 1.0, 0 coerced to 1.0), sets g_ui_scale/_is_non_default and rescales five base UI metrics. Unported; the port has no ddraw.ini reader and fixes the HUD strip at 0xC2.

name: PlayerTick_MouseCoordinateBridge
comment: INTERNAL LABEL of 0x0044AA70; not a function. Far bridge adjusts the saved cursor coordinate by the gameplay viewport offset and jumps to 0x0044E019; equivalent coordinate handling is folded into the reimplementation rather than ported one-to-one.
